evidence.decision: Defines the semantic unit and stable identity before choosing commit triggers, completion timing, correction and transfer operations.
evidence.artifact: Requires a text-to-token lifecycle or implementation with commit/completion/identity/edit/transfer behavior.
evidence.transformation: Ambiguous Alex recipient example prevents automatic wrong-contact commitment and preserves an identifier during transfer rather than copying the display name.
evidence.verification: Exercises ambiguous names, unfinished entry, comma/Return, deletion, reorder and cross-field movement, failing lost identity or uncorrectable tokens.
evidence.applicability: Explicit Mac component scope is separated from search tokens elsewhere; native input/pasteboard execution remains a distinct check.
evidence.handoffs: Loads search-fields for query refinement, text-fields for ordinary entry and context-menus only for useful token actions.
evidence.distinctiveness: Commit delimiters, completion interruption, recipient identity and manipulable tokens create a specific token-field workflow.
